videos.subtitle_summary:

Key points from the text:
1. US government partially reduced high tariffs on steel, aluminum, copper derivative products from 25% to 15% for certain items like Korean-made forklifts, bulldozers, tractors
2. This applies to countries with separate tariff agreements with US (Korea, Japan, EU)
3. However, aluminum printing plates and steel racks were newly added to tariff list at 25%
4. Research shows US 50% steel tariffs could cause Korea GDP loss of about 3.2 trillion won
5. Steel industry is urging government for follow-up measures to K-Steel Act as support is delayed
6. Pohang and Gyeongbuk steel exports declined 18% over 5 years due to Chinese low-price competition and US tariffs
